build.buildCommand: cd system && composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader && npm install && npm run build && php artisan config:cache && php artisan route:cache

deploy.startCommand: mkdir -p "${UPLOADS_PATH:-public/storage/app}" && (cd system && php artisan db:seed --class=DummyDraftRencanaDidoSeeder --force && php artisan db:seed --class=DummyDraftLaporanLangsungDidoSeeder --force && php artisan db:seed --class=DummyDraftLaporanRencanaDidoSeeder --force || true) && php -c system/php.ini -S 0.0.0.0:$PORT server.php
